text:
maya: Seeing invoice-preview bounce for a handful of tenants after the routing fallback change. looks like when clients switch transport mid-session we get two route_ids and preview sums both. ledger dedupes by request_id so customers see spikes only in preview.

tony: Can you drop a sample?

maya: redacted: 
```
{"request_id":"rq-501","tenant":"t-horizon","route_id":"r/stream-low-latency","transport":"ws","tokens":60}
...later...
{"request_id":"rq-501","tenant":"t-horizon","route_id":"r/batch-failover","transport":"http","tokens":58}
```

lee: So the route-decider changes route_id during same request_id lifecycle. preview pipeline groups by route so we double-count.

olivia: Two options: upstream stable billing_id, or downstream preview coalesce by request_id when present. Upstream is cleaner but touches many pieces.

ton y: (typo) Downstream is lower risk for a fast fix. Does preview have request_id for most events?

maya: ~93% have it. a few legacy proxies drop it.

lee: Proposed short-term: patch preview aggregator to group by request_id if present, otherwise fallback to current keying. add feature flag preview.group_by_request_id.

olivia: Good. Add sampled logging for events without request_id so we know coverage for upstream rollout. Also add metric preview_requestid_coverage per tenant.

tony: rollout plan: canary 5% tenants for 30m, compare preview vs ledger delta and CPU. rollback flip flag.

metering-bot: Created ticket MET-4987: "preview double-count from mid-session transport flip" and attached sample traces.

lee: For long-term: add optional `billing_id` header emitted by route-decider and persisted for session (TTL 24h). ingestion will dual-write keys tenant|billing_id and tenant|route_id for 48h during migration, then flip. I'll draft migration steps.

olivia: Proto sketch: optional string billing_id in ingest proto; consumers should fallback to request_id/route_id when absent. document compatibility and test dual-write path.

maya: add a debug header x-billing-debug that we can turn on per-tenant so we can track events end-to-end during canary.

ton y: PR incoming for preview patch with unit + perf tests. ETA canary in ~2h.

olivia: Dashboards: add card showing preview delta by transport change and a small histogram of token delta when route_id changes. alert if delta > 12% for top 40 tenants.

lee: Action items: tony -> land preview flagged patch + canary (MET-4987); olivia -> proto RFC + kafka migration doc; maya -> dashboard + run sample queries to quantify missing request_id; me (lee) -> design billing_id dual-write plan. target: mitigation canary today, RFC by tomorrow noon.

metering-bot: Noted assignees and ETA on MET-4987.
